Confidence is moderate-low because the listing mixes past/future without a clear upcoming filter, and no strictly future Manifesten-specific event title could be verified as of 2026-09-12.

source.reasoning: Web search found mucem.org as the official site. A scan revealed the Nuxt front-end fetches events client-side from /wp-json/wpnuxt/v1/posts/evenement, proxied via /api/mainApi/posts/evenement. Fetching this endpoint with upcoming=1&perPage=100 (largest page size, no page param) returned 200 JSON with a 'list' of 42 upcoming events, including full titles, dates and images, confirming it covers the whole upcoming agenda in one call.

rules.notes: Covers events whose sessions are listed as discrete unique dated occurrences.
Covers events that only define a recurrence range (has_recurrence true) without individual unique session dates; represented as a single range event from start_date to end_date.

schema.notes: Mucem events API. Root list at "list". Each item has meta.sessions with either event__unique (list of single dated sessions {date,start_time,end_time}) or has_recurrence true with event__recurrent {start_date,end_date,start_time,end_time,recurrence[]}. We expand event__unique to get one event per session (covers dated occurrences like the 6 upcoming events seen, e.g. visite multisensorielle recurring on several unique dates). Title, url, location, price and free come from the parent item, referenced via "item." prefix. Dates in event__unique use %Y%m%d format, times %H:%M. Location is nested list at meta.practical_info.location, take first entry's post_title. Price from meta.practical_info.rates first rate value if present; free flag from meta.free_event boolean.
